basis: The dashboard shows May as the lowest bar on the chart, with a value visibly below the 10,000 kWh mark on the y-axis. All other months (Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar) have significantly higher values, ranging from approximately 17,500 kWh to 40,000 kWh. This extreme deviation from the other months' usage levels indicates a critical low-usage anomaly rather than a standard low-usage case.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-usage anomaly review
